docs/superpowers/specs/2026-05-06-enrichment-module-design.md:285:#### 4.2 数据迁移（expand-contract）
docs/superpowers/specs/2026-05-02-postgresql-snowflake-migration-design.md:9:MX Space Core currently persists application data through MongoDB, Mongoose, and Typegoose. The migration target is PostgreSQL with a type-safe repository layer and Snowflake IDs as the canonical identity model.
docs/superpowers/specs/2026-05-02-postgresql-snowflake-migration-design.md:11:The migration is a hard database cutover. MongoDB remains only as the source for the one-time migration tool and as historical backup input. After cutover, application runtime code must not depend on MongoDB, Mongoose, Typegoose, Mongo ObjectId, `mongodump`, or `mongorestore`.
docs/superpowers/specs/2026-05-02-postgresql-snowflake-migration-design.md:17:| Weak type guarantees | MongoDB document shape is flexible and Mongoose typing is not authoritative enough at business boundaries. | PostgreSQL schema and repository DTOs become the source of truth. |
docs/superpowers/specs/2026-05-02-postgresql-snowflake-migration-design.md:18:| Difficult structural migration | Historical Mongo migrations mutate loosely typed documents and require defensive runtime checks. | Schema changes are explicit SQL migrations with typed data transforms. |

packages/mongo-pg-cli/README.md:1:# @mx-space/mongo-pg-cli
packages/mongo-pg-cli/README.md:3:One-shot **MongoDB → PostgreSQL** data migration CLI for upgrading [mx-space](https://github.com/mx-space/core) from v11 to v12.
packages/mongo-pg-cli/README.md:5:The CLI is a single self-contained ES module bundle that ships every Drizzle migration SQL file alongside it. It reads a v11 mongo database, allocates Snowflake IDs, runs the v12 schema migrations, then loads every row into the target PostgreSQL — with a dry-run mode that validates references before writing anything.
packages/mongo-pg-cli/README.md:12:npx @mx-space/mongo-pg-cli@latest --mode dry-run
packages/mongo-pg-cli/README.md:18:npm i -g @mx-space/mongo-pg-cli
packages/mongo-pg-cli/README.md:19:mx-mongo-pg-migrate --mode apply
packages/mongo-pg-cli/README.md:26:| `--mode dry-run` (default) | Reads from Mongo, allocates Snowflake IDs, walks every reference. Writes nothing. Reports row counts and missing/orphan references. |
packages/mongo-pg-cli/README.md:33:| `MONGO_URI` | `mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/mx-space` | Source v11 MongoDB URI. `DB_CONNECTION_STRING` also accepted. |

packages/mongo-pg-cli/README.md:67:`apply` mode is **safe to re-run** — every insert uses `ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`, and the persisted id map ensures resumed runs reuse the same Snowflake IDs. The CLI never writes back to MongoDB.
